title: One Drawer and Forty Labels
subtitle: 收藏与藏品 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 收藏与藏品（文学艺术与体育·收藏与鉴赏）
meta: 主题语境：收藏与藏品（文学艺术与体育·收藏与鉴赏）　|　核心词汇：collection　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 collection 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 my grandfather ① made a collection of bus tickets he had never used, and he said the making was the whole of the hobby. The ② collection, meaning the tickets and not the album, filled one drawer and stayed there; collection, he said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how little of it is ever used.

Every ③ collection in that house had the same label, and the ④ collection at the end, meaning the one he kept locked and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever asked about twice. Collection, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to keep a label; my grandfather said the patience is the part that fills the drawer.

My mother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ taking the collection was the whole of the Sunday, meaning the plate and not the tickets. The ⑥ collection, meaning the money and not any of that, is the only thing in a Sunday that everybody gives to and nobody counts; collection, she said, is either something you label or the only word that means both a drawer and a plate. He said the plate is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ collection had become a line in a catalogue, and the catalogue had become an argument about what belonged together. The ⑧ collection of the whole thing, my mother wrote in May, was one drawer and forty years of labels; collection, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to keep a ticket. She said the ticket was never mentioned.

The ⑨ collection I remember is the one at the end, which was catalogued in 1974 and is still described as the most complete in the county. A ⑩ collection, my grandmother said in 1976, is the only thing that improves by being added to; every collection, she said, is a patience that has agreed to look like a drawer. She said the patience was the honest half.

answers.why: make a collection of 意为“收集、搜集……”，1957 年祖父收集了一批从未用过的公交车票。
collection 意为“收藏品”，指那一柜藏品本身而不是那本册子，装满了一个抽屉。
collection 指那栋房子里每一批收藏，每一批都有同样的标签。
collection 指末尾那一批（他锁起来的那一批），是唯一有人问过两次的。
take the collection 意为“（教堂）募捐、收款”，母亲说募捐就是那个星期天的全部。
collection 意为“募捐、募集到的钱”，指那个盘子里的钱，是星期天里人人都给、却没人去数的东西。
collection 意为“收藏品”，到 1969 年这批藏品成了目录里的一行。
collection 意为“汇编、全集”，母亲五月写道，整件事的汇编是一个抽屉和四十年的标签。
collection 意为“收藏品”，我记得的是末尾那一批，1974 年编目，至今仍被说成全县最完整的。
collection 为抽象总称，祖母说一批收藏是唯一会因为被增添而变好的东西。
